title: Feature Request: Option to Disable Automatic Model Fallback (Pro to Flash)

labels.name: priority/p3
labels.description: Backlog - a good idea but not currently a priority.

labels.name: area/core
labels.description: Issues related to User Interface, OS Support, Core Functionality

body:
### What would you like to be added?

Desired Behavior/Feature Request:

I would like to request an option (e.g., a command-line flag or a setting in settings.json) to disable the automatic model fallback. My goal is to consistently use the gemini-1.5-pro model without any automatic switching to gemini-2.0-flash.

Current Behavior:

The Gemini CLI currently includes an automatic model fallback mechanism where, if the default "pro" model (e.g., gemini-1.5-pro) experiences rate limiting or slow responses, the CLI automatically switches to the "flash" model (e.g., gemini-2.0-flash) for the remainder of the session. This behavior is documented as a way to ensure continuity and prevent interruptions.

Proposed Solution: 

Consider adding a configuration option such as:
* A command-line flag: --no-model-fallback when launching the CLI.
* A setting in ~/.gemini/settings.json or project-specific .gemini/settings.json:

   1     {
   2       "disableModelFallback": true
   3     }

### Why is this needed?

Justification/User Circumstances:

While I understand the intent behind the fallback mechanism (to maintain continuity), for my specific use cases, the capabilities and consistency of the gemini-1.5-pro model are paramount. The larger context window and potentially more robust reasoning of the Pro model are crucial for my tasks.

Automatic switching to the Flash model, even if temporary, can lead to:
* Inconsistent output quality or behavior within a single session.
* A need to re-evaluate or re-prompt if the Flash model's response is not suitable for the task initiated with the Pro model.

I would prefer to experience potential interruptions (e.g., rate limit errors or delays) if it means ensuring that all interactions within a session are handled by the explicitly chosen gemini-1.5-pro model.

Thank you for considering this feature request.
